name: AUDIT-FB1029e-T-KB-first-key-only
old:
for (const code of held) keyUp(code);
    for (const code of held) if (keys.delete(code)) noteKeyUp(edges, code);
new:
for (const code of held.slice(0, 1)) keyUp(code);
    for (const code of held.slice(0, 1)) if (keys.delete(code)) noteKeyUp(edges, code);

name: AUDIT-FB1029e-T-FR-had-any-account
old: const had = await db.prepare('SELECT 1 AS h FROM lineages WHERE player = ? AND id = ?').bind(playerId, id).first();
new:
const had = await db
    .prepare('SELECT 1 AS h FROM lineages WHERE (player = ? OR 1) AND id = ?')
    .bind(playerId, id)
    .first();
